headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"
headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Yoav Gallant warned Hamas that if an Israeli soldier or citizen is abducted, the entire city of Gaza will be evacuated. Speaking at a memorial ceremony, Gallant clarified that Israel would not back down from its red line in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the Strip is demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, stating they had eliminated its nuclear threat and emphasized that their work is not finished.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"

headlines.title: מקרון באמירה מקוממת: "חמאס מעולם לא פעל בגדה המערבית"
headlines.snippet: French President Emmanuel Macron stated at the UN General Assembly that Hamas has never operated in the West Bank, questioning the justification for violations there. He asserted the need to respect the Palestinian people's right to exist. Benjamin Netanyahu responded, calling the statement absurd and highlighting that a French citizen was recently killed by a Hamas terrorist in the West Bank. Izko Eisenkot also commented that the statement was extremely detached from reality.

headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron, who was killed in a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest. Family, friends, and residents attended the funeral. His 16-year-old son, Yoav, who was with him during the attack, bid farewell, thanking his father for his life. His wife, Merav, described him as a very involved father, and his sister, Ruti, remembered him as a pleasant, wise, and humble person.

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron was identified as the victim of a shooting attack near Benjamin, and the perpetrator was apprehended at a hospital in Ramallah. A terrorist opened fire on people at a spring near Neve Tzuf, then fled. Natanel Shkaron, a father of six from Alon Shvut, was critically injured and later died at the hospital. After an extensive manhunt, commandos arrested the terrorist inside a hospital in Ramallah. Another terrorist was neutralized while attempting a car-ramming attack in the northern West Bank.
